svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Web app on Azure
svg.desc: Web app on Azure. 8 components in 5 groups. Connections: Users to Azure Front Door (HTTPS); Azure Front Door to App Service; App Service to Private endpoint; Private endpoint to Azure SQL Database; App Service to Private endpoint; Private endpoint to Key Vault; Application Insights to App Service.

text.tspan: Front Door sends traffic to App Service, which reaches Azure SQL and Key Vault through private endpoints over VNet integration
